name: gollabara
description: Your sessions stream. You pick, you look. A local app that gathers the screenshots, mockups, recaps, and questions from your Claude Code, Codex, Open Design, and Claude Design sessions into one stream.

paragraphs: A local web app that gathers only the artifacts your Open Design, Claude Code, Codex, and Claude Design sessions produce (screenshots, design mockups, end-of-turn recaps, and the questions sessions ask) into a single stream. Keep it on a side monitor or your phone, watch it flow, and step in only when you need to.

As a UX engineer building client apps, I constantly make decisions and give feedback while looking at screenshots and mockups. At the same time, I run client development sessions and need to watch them and step in now and then. That work spans Open Design, Claude Code, Codex, and Claude Design. What I needed was not a dashboard that pulls every session into one place, but a view that follows the flow through its artifacts.

whatItDoes.text: A local web app that gathers only the artifacts your Open Design, Claude Code, Codex, and Claude Design sessions produce (screenshots, design mockups, end-of-turn recaps, and the questions sessions ask) into a single stream. Keep it on a side monitor or your phone, watch it flow, and step in only when you need to.

requirements.text: setup installs gollabara under /.gollabara, starts the server as a login service on macOS ( and installs the plugin into Claude Code and Codex CLI when claude or codex is on your PATH.
